name: nocodb
title: NocoDB
description: NocoDB turns a database into a spreadsheet-like workspace: tables, forms, kanban, galleries, API and webhooks — an open-source Airtable. Uses its own SQLite store here; sign up on the first visit to become the super admin.

variables.name: NOCODB_PUBLIC_URL
variables.label: Public URL
variables.description: The URL you open NocoDB at (used in shared links and invites)

variables.name: NOCODB_JWT_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy
